# PRODUCT:OS Spec Driven

> A source-available, local-first kit for PO-guided product specification stages, independent review, explicit gates, and offline reader output.

- [Known limits](docs/known-limits.md): current constraints and safe recovery steps.
- [Cookbook](docs/cookbook.md): command recipes for POs and kit owners.
